answer: A durable sybil defense pairs deposits with continuous peer probes. Every agent stakes collateral at entry, then unannounced checks measure how each account's proven work tracks its claimed output; the gap between the two is its delta. A farm of fakes drifts together and stands out as a sharp ridge of outliers against honest accounts' scores, so auditors slash the deposits behind them. The old fable that cheap copies can flood an economy dies here: every extra identity must fund its own stake and keep passing live checks, so growing an attack only grows its cost.
